author: Boddaert, 1783
summary: 어른새는 온몸이 초콜릿빛 갈색이고 배와 날개 아랫면에만 흰 깃이 있는 새다. 얼굴, 부리, 다리의 색으로 암수를 가를 수 있다. 오래 사는 개체는 16년 정도까지 사는 것으로 알려져 있다.

points.en: face, bill and leg colour differ between sexes

sexes.male: 얼굴, 부리, 다리가 회색빛 도는 녹색이고 목은 푸른빛을 띤다.

young: 어린새는 배와 날개 아랫면이 밝은 갈색인 점만 빼면 어른새와 비슷하다.

art.subject: Brown Booby (Sula leucogaster), adult male: head, neck, upper breast, back, wings and tail dark chocolate-brown, the brown ending in a sharp, straight line across the lower breast; lower breast, belly and undertail coverts clean white; underwing coverts white in the centre with broad brown borders and brown flight feathers; bill long, conical and pointed, greyish-green; bare facial skin around the eye and at the bill base greyish-green, the bare throat skin bluish; feet greyish-green.
art.scene: open sea around a rocky islet off southern Korea in late summer, waves breaking on dark basalt rocks; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing on a sea rock: chocolate-brown head, neck, upper breast and upperparts, sharp line to the white belly, greyish-green bill and bare face, bluish throat skin, greyish-green feet
adult female, side view standing: the same chocolate-brown and white pattern, slightly larger, with yellow bill, yellow bare face and yellow feet
adult, in flight seen from below: chocolate-brown head, neck, breast and flight feathers, white belly and a white central band on the underwing coverts, long pointed wings, wedge-shaped tail
art.build: Large, cigar-shaped seabird, 71–76cm, clearly larger than a Black-tailed Gull, with a long neck, long pointed wings and a long wedge-shaped tail. Bill long, straight, thick-based and tapering to a sharp point without a hook, about as long as the head. Legs short with large webbed feet. At rest the long wings cross over the tail. Flies low over the waves with stiff wingbeats and glides, and plunge-dives at an angle for fish.
avoid: Do not paint a hooked bill (cormorant or frigatebird); the booby's bill is straight and pointed.
Do not paint a white head or white upperwing coverts (Masked Booby); the head, neck and upperparts are wholly brown.
Do not let the brown breast blend into the belly; the border is sharp and straight.
Do not paint a forked tail; it is wedge-shaped.
